text:
sasha-pse: Kicked off POC call with NovaPay. They want streaming SSE with function/tool calls, structured JSON outputs, and SSO + KMS for keys. Need quick answers on: 1) ephemeral creds for streaming, 2) on-prem vs hosted latency numbers, 3) pricing estimate for reserved capacity (2x GPU). Also security wants SOC2 checklist answers. Who can help?

devon_se: I can take SDK + streaming. For ephemeral creds we have short-lived tokens via STS for Dedicated; for hosted we issue ephemeral JWTs for SSE. Example snippet: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <short-token>' 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream'
```

marcus_eng: For tool calls they want JSON-LD structured output. We support function-calls with schema validation. Recommend adding a small client wrapper to assert schema on delta events + final payload. Sample validate hook: ```js
if (event.type === 'tool') validateSchema(event.payload, schema)
```

anna_sales: Pricing: ballpark for a 2x A100 reserved pool (24/7) + 5M tokens/month streaming is ~$45k/month. I'll pull precise quote from comp plan and include burst options. Need to know model choices (quantized vs fp16, seq len).

elaine_security: NovaPay's security questionnaire flagged KMS integration & key rotation policy. Redwood supports customer-managed KMS in Private mode and Dedicated with VPC; rotation policies are enforced by the customer's KMS. We need the customer KMS ARN and a limited IAM role or service principal.

legal_bot: Sharing DPA + SOC2 summary here: https://redwood-internal/docs/compliance/soc2-summary. Also will attach the standard subprocessor list.

devon_se: Small integration gotcha: SSE clients must handle 204 heartbeats; we send keepalive every 15s. Also prefix/KV cache helps cost but is disabled for structured tool outputs unless they opt-in (to avoid consistency issues).

marcus_eng: Latency SLOs: hosted 95th percentile token latency ~80ms for seq len 512 on small models; Dedicated under committed QPS can drop to ~30ms depending on quantization and batch config. Will add perf table for A100 config.

anna_sales: Action items: 1) @devon_se produce quick sample repo (stream + toolcall + webhook example) 2) @marcus_eng add perf table + SLOs 3) @elaine_security send KMS IAM snippet + network diagram 4) @anna_sales finalize pricing quote. Target demo by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

devon_se: I'll push a minimal repo under sandbox/novapay-poc and share link by EOD. Quick question — do they need function-calls sync or async? @sasha-pse

sasha-pse: They prefer async callbacks via webhook to their adapter. Also they asked about retry/backpressure semantics for webhook failures.

marcus_eng: We have retries with exponential backoff for webhooks + dead-letter to SQS for Private deployments. For hosted we can enable a per-route retry window (default 24h) and drop to DLQ after window. Backpressure: SDK exposes client-side buffer + server will return 429 when queue is saturated.

elaine_security: For questionnaires, they asked about network isolation. Private provides VPC peering and on-prem has an air-gapped package. I'll attach a short network diagram and required firewall rules.

anna_sales: Cool. @devon_se once repo link is up I'll schedule the demo and attach the pricing sheet. Any blockers otherwise?

devon_se: None from my side. I need confirmation on which model variant they want (optimize for latency vs quality).

sasha-pse: I'll confirm model choice in follow-up with the customer and post here. Thanks everyone. :pray:
